headline: Four keeps the last heat.
body: The cup on the sill has gone cold; its steam stopped some time ago. A moth rests flat against the shade and does not lift. Down the block a single door closes, then the street returns to its ordinary silence.

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: desk lamp lowered, amber thinning at the rim

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: empty curb, faint wet sheen from earlier rain

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: deep blue, first pale thinning along the east
